openFindings.title: A rejected memory proposal records the scope once, so the grant reads as an approval
openFindings.evidence: The answer path wrote the grant scope from the derived scope, and a reject derived deny only after the write, so the stored grant read once.
openFindings.recommendation: Derive the scope before the write and write the grant from the derived value.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg -n 'grantedBy|grant.scope' .skilled/skills/system-skilled-bots/runtime/lib printed 4 producers and 2 readers, all of which read the stored scope.

openFindings.title: The chat transcript prints a bare array, so a reader has no version to branch on
openFindings.evidence: The transcript verb printed the message array directly, against the envelope rule every other --json verb follows.
openFindings.recommendation: Print the object envelope with version, conversationId and messages.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg -n 'JSON.stringify' .skilled/bin/bots.cjs printed 11 verbs, of which 3 printed a bare array.

openFindings.title: The inbox listing reads a lock file as an item when the lock carries a json suffix
openFindings.evidence: The listing filtered on a .json suffix, and the lock path the answer seam takes ends in .lock, so the filter held only because of the suffix.
openFindings.recommendation: Filter on the item id shape as well as the suffix.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg -n 'endsWith' .skilled/skills/system-skilled-bots/runtime/lib/needs-you.ts printed one hit, the listing filter.

openFindings.title: The runtime README lists 28 modules where the folder holds 51 after the packet
openFindings.evidence: The README's group table names the modules that existed before the packet and no later phase updated it.
openFindings.recommendation: Regenerate the group table from the folder listing.
openFindings.scopeProof: ls .skilled/skills/system-skilled-bots/runtime/lib/*.ts | wc -l printed 51 against the README's 28.
openFindings.deferReason: The README is a documentation surface no phase of this build owns, and rewriting it is a documentation change rather than a fix to a defect the review named.

resolvedFindings.title: The answer verb refuses a non-confirm text with exit 2
resolvedFindings.evidence: The lineage read the phase line and reported the exit code it names.
resolvedFindings.recommendation: None. The contract already fixes exit 4 for every answer refusal.
resolvedFindings.scopeProof: rg -n 'review-answer-invalid' specs/system-skilled-bots/003-openbot-parity-build/contracts/refusals.md printed the row that fixes exit 4.
resolvedFindings.closedReason: Withdrawn at triage. The contract row settles the exit code and the phase line is the one WO-04 corrects, so the finding names a document already scheduled for repair rather than a defect.
